answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 1645 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the wander. The thread index is deterministic from ledger replay, and as a result nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes anyone to the back of the delta queue while honest participants promoted earlier goes on earning. The fee repeats 16 times over. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
